$comment: Machine-readable feature tracker. WIP=1: only ONE feature may be 'in_progress' at a time. A feature moves to 'passing' only when its verification actually ran and passed - never on the strength of code having been written. Statuses: not_started | in_progress | blocked | passing. Order is the intended implementation order.

features.title: Menubar control surface
features.user_visible_behavior: A menubar (status bar) item appears with no Dock icon and no window; its title/icon reflects the current mode (jazz/phonk). Its menu offers Play/Pause, Toggle mode, Settings, and Quit.
verification: make dev then observe: status item present, no Dock icon, menu items wired (Quit works, Toggle flips the shown mode)
features.notes: Scaffold already shows a minimal status item + Quit in Sources/PhonkJazz/main.swift; grow it into an AppController that owns Mode.

features.title: AppConfig model + persistence
features.user_visible_behavior: Two playlist URLs (jazz, phonk) plus the shortcut are held in an AppConfig, persisted as JSON under Application Support with sensible defaults; missing/corrupt config falls back to defaults without crashing.
verification: make test — Core unit tests: encode/decode round-trip, default fallback, URL validation
features.notes: Lives in PhonkJazzCore (pure, testable). No AppKit here.

features.title: Embed YouTube Music web player with persistent login
features.user_visible_behavior: A (hidden/off-screen) WKWebView loads music.youtube.com using a persistent data store; the user can sign into Google in-app once and remains logged in across relaunches.
verification: make dev: sign in, quit, relaunch — still logged in; music.youtube.com loads authenticated
features.notes: Use WKWebsiteDataStore.default(). Never log/commit session cookies. See docs/ytmusic-integration.md.

features.title: JS-injected playback control
features.user_visible_behavior: The app can load a given playlist URL in the WebView and start/pause playback via evaluateJavaScript; audio actually plays.
verification: make dev: trigger play — audio starts; trigger pause — audio stops
features.notes: Centralize all DOM selectors in one place (they are unstable). Handle autoplay user-gesture requirement.

features.title: Toggle playlist by mode
features.user_visible_behavior: Invoking toggle flips jazz<->phonk: loads the other mode's playlist, starts it playing, and updates the menubar to reflect the new mode.
verification: make test — Core: Mode.toggled + config lookup returns the correct playlist URL
make dev — toggling switches the playing playlist and updates the status item
features.notes: Mode enum + toggle invariant already in Core (ModeTests). Wire it to config lookup + WebView + status item.

features.title: Global toggle shortcut (Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J)
features.user_visible_behavior: Pressing Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J from any app toggles the mode, with no Accessibility permission prompt.
verification: make dev: focus another app, press Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+J, confirm the playlist toggles
features.notes: Carbon RegisterEventHotKey (see DECISIONS.md). No third-party dependency.

features.title: Settings window to edit playlists
features.user_visible_behavior: Selecting Settings opens a small window where the user pastes/edits the jazz and phonk playlist URLs; saving persists them (config-persistence) and takes effect for the next toggle.
verification: make dev: open Settings, change a playlist URL, save, toggle — new playlist is used
features.notes: Validate URLs via Core before saving. Depends on config-persistence.

features.title: Assemble distributable menubar .app bundle
features.user_visible_behavior: `make app` produces a PhonkJazz.app with an Info.plist marking it LSUIElement (menubar-only), launchable by double-click and eligible as a login item.
verification: make app then open PhonkJazz.app — launches as menubar-only, no Dock icon
features.notes: Makefile 'app' target currently exits 1 as a placeholder. Assemble bundle around the swift build product.
